title: Maple Miso Steelhead with Broccolini & Potatoes
ingredients: 4 steelhead trout or salmon fillets (6 oz each)
2 tbsp white or red miso paste
1 tsp freshly grated ginger & 1 clove garlic, minced
1 lb baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved
1 tbsp olive oil, salt, black pepper, and toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss halved baby potatoes with 1/2 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan and roast head-start for 12 minutes.
Whisk together the miso paste, maple syrup, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, grated ginger, and garlic until smooth.
Remove the sheet pan, push potatoes to one side, add broccolini tossed with olive oil and a pinch of salt, and place steelhead fillets skin-side down in the center.
Brush fillets generously with the maple-miso glaze and roast for 10–12 minutes (broiling the last 2 minutes) until caramelized and flaky. Garnish with sesame seeds.
